unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U16: Distinguish liquidation choices, waterfall categories and the amended security-value limitation

payload.title: A security election changes the distribution analysis
payload.core_explanation_md:
A secured creditor liquidation file must distinguish relinquishing security to the estate from separately realising it under the applicable route. Surplus, shortfall, costs and distribution are not the same amount. The 2026 section 53 clarification limits the relinquishing creditor secured treatment to the determined security value where that value is below the debt; the remainder is treated as unsecured. Do not teach that relinquishment guarantees full-debt priority.

The waterfall also separates insolvency/liquidation costs, the specified workmen/secured-creditor tier, employee dues, financial unsecured debts and later categories. Excluded provident/pension/gratuity funds are not simply another distributable tier. Fast-track resolution, MSME pre-pack and solvent voluntary liquidation are distinct routes with their own conditions.

self_check.prompt_text: Does relinquishing security necessarily give the whole debt secured-tier treatment?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Apply the amended valuation limitation and other distribution conditions.

payload.stem_md: Debt exceeds the stipulated value of relinquished security. A note gives secured-tier treatment to the whole debt without examining the 2026 clarification. What is required?

options.text_md: Treat security value as always equal to the debt
Separate the secured extent and unsecured remainder under the amended provision
options.explanation_md: The clarification makes valuation material to classification.

options.text_md: Ignore the waterfall whenever a bank is involved
options.explanation_md: Bank status does not remove distribution law.

options.text_md: Count excluded employee funds as free estate cash

payload.correct_explanation_md: The clarification makes valuation material to classification.

payload.stem_md: A distressed entity selects voluntary liquidation solely because it wants a faster process, without checking the no-default and solvency conditions. What is missing?

options.text_md: The route-specific eligibility, declarations and approval conditions
options.explanation_md: A desired speed does not establish voluntary-liquidation eligibility.
A title change does not satisfy the legal route.

options.text_md: An assumption that fast-track, pre-pack and liquidation are identical
A promise that every creditor receives full payment automatically
options.explanation_md: The legal and financial facts must support the claim.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A desired speed does not establish voluntary-liquidation eligibility.
